scope: Synthetic local SCRAM PostgreSQL, restricted service runtime, HTTP/BFF, isolated 040 and 041 source. 040 web source against the actual current BFF uses a Node IndexedDB implementation. Browser/device validation is a separate run.
subject: b0565fb (041) with cd2cc12, a30a9b2, 7449efb, ae79727, fec58e1 and 76b3c6f

findings.upgrade: Seeded two households on schema 040. pg_dump / pg_restore then migrated to 041. 103 original tables match counts, SHA-256 row contents, ACLs, policies and RLS; 40 registry entries preserved. New table starts empty with forced RLS and zero preexisting grants.
findings.restore: With positive grants present on two households, a full dump/restore preserved all 104 tables and all 41 registry entries. Raw restored old opted-in generation improperly accepted a request superseded in the newer source database. Verified quarantine plan clears every queue grant, verifies zero at release and refuses a reinserted grant. Fresh opt-in creates a distinct generation; ordinary received request history, sibling devices and source data remain available under their original authority.
findings.database_only_recovery: For a restore outside signed journal tooling, block application traffic and clear ritc.request_queue_permission on verified quarantine before allowing access. An isolated raw dump cannot learn of a later opt-out.
findings.runtime: Checked bounded generation and validity interval, scoped household/device/role and selected helper denial, grant disable/re-enable, replay window, signed worker erasure, household exit and organizer SECURITY DEFINER revoke. A committed exact request can return its prior receipt for the original authenticated contributor, device, queue generation and live replay window; changed payload, foreign/replaced grants and never-committed requests are rejected.
findings.clients: Released compiled 040 API + IndexedDB outbox before fix retained offline text and sent a generation-free command after two grant rotations. With repaired 041 response, direct online send succeeds and old IndexedDB rejects retaining it. 041 PUT and session decode the same explicit grant/expiry; legacy boolean remains false.
